subject: Bug with facet_grid and combining variables in one direction?

messages.author: eca99c51870663ea
messages.subject: Bug with facet_grid and combining variables in one direction?
parts:
I tried "adding" two variables in a faceting formula for facet_wrap, and it just threw some errors. I even tried an example directly from the help page for facet_wrap, and that didn't work. Is this a bug?

# These are equivalent, and neither works
qplot(mpg, wt, data=mtcars, facets = vs + am ~ . )
qplot(mpg, wt, data=mtcars) + facet_grid(vs + am ~ . )
#Error in rbind(c("spacer", "strip_h", "spacer"), c("axis_v", "axis_v",  :
#  number of columns of matrices must match (see arg 2)
#In addition: Warning message:
#In rbind(list(1, 1, 1), list(0.450050427161222, 1, 0.524033385806113,  :
#  number of columns of result is not a multiple of vector length (arg 1)


qplot(mpg, wt, data=mtcars, facets = . ~ vs + am )
#Error in cbind("spacer", c("strip_h", "strip_h", "strip_h", "strip_h",  :
#  number of rows of matrices must match (see arg 2)


# This works
qplot(mpg, wt, data=mtcars, facets = vs ~ am)

# facet_wrap seems to work
qplot(mpg, wt, data=mtcars) + facet_wrap( ~ vs+am)


-Winston
